name: okf-abstracts
description: OKF v0.2 abstract class ontology (foundational -> core -> domain -> application layers). Shared class definitions for OKF v0.2 knowledge bundles. Requires okf-skills for compliance validation.

interface.shortDescription: OKF v0.2 abstract class ontology (L0-L3 layers)
interface.longDescription: OKF Abstracts provides the shared class ontology for OKF v0.2 knowledge bundles. Classes are organized into four OWL-style layers (foundational L0, core L1, domain L2, application L3) with 105 class definitions. Concepts in other bundles reference these via subtype_of frontmatter. REQUIRES okf-skills (https://github.com/scaccogatto/okf-skills) for full OKF v0.2 compliance validation — run okf-skills first for spec compliance, then okf-abstracts skills for subtype coherence.
defaultPrompt: Validate subtype_of linkage against okf-abstracts classes
Generate a new OKF bundle using okf-abstracts classes
Check if my concept headers match abstract class requirements
